sections.title: Ye company kya karti hai?
sections.content: Graphy India-based creator-economy platform hai — educators, coaches, experts courses, memberships, live learning se monetize karte hain.

sections.title: Customers kaun hain?
sections.content: Independent educators, coaches, trainers — India aur global creator-education markets. Secondary: enrolled learners aur community members.

sections.title: Products / services kya hain?
sections.content: Course hosting, community, payments, creator mobile apps, marketing tools, live classes, memberships — all-in-one creator stack.

sections.title: Business model kya hai?
sections.content: SaaS subscriptions + platform fees on creator revenue. Growth = creators ko jaldi succeed karwana, churn kam, community/live se ARPU badhana.

sections.title: Recent kya matter karta hai?
sections.content: Creator-education mein competition badh rahi hai. Focus: mobile creator workflows, community retention, one-off courses se aage jaana.

sections.title: Hiring patterns kya dikhte hain?
sections.content: Product, engineering, growth, customer success hiring — scaling creator SaaS signal. AJ ko product pe teacher experience hai.

sections.title: Strategic challenges kya ho sakte hain?
sections.content: Course hosting se differentiate karna padega — better UX, AI workflows, community depth chahiye. Educator onboarding critical lever hai.

sections.title: AJ yahan value kaise create kar sakta hai?
